text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit eastbound and westbound U-turn movements at all times on Toledo Road, between Renforth Drive and a point 200 metres west of Renforth Drive.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing eastbound and westbound U-turn prohibition, in effect at all times on Toledo Road, between Mills Road and Renforth Drive, to be in effect between Renforth Drive and a point 200 metres west.
